name: Step Parents
overview: Scripture upholds the sacred responsibility of honoring and instructing parents, emphasizing the importance of nurturing children in the fear and knowledge of the Lord. Though the sample verses focus on biological parents, the principles of honoring authority (Exodus 20:12), heartfelt obedience (Proverbs 1:8), loving discipline (Proverbs 13:24), and faithful training (Proverbs 22:6) apply to all who undertake the role of guiding and raising children. Recognizing children as a heritage from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), step parents are called to embrace their God-given duty to lovingly instruct and care for their stepchildren, reflecting the heart of God’s covenantal family.
